name: chat-chip
title: Chat Chip
description: A compact pill for background work and counts — "7 background commands done, 3 running ›" — on the chat card surface, with an attention tone that never adds a status fill.

meta.whenToUse: Live or partly failed background work, Subagents running, or a count that opens a panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Settled work (a muted line), a person's own things such as a Doc or a PR (a resource pill), or a filter or tag (Chip).
